# Consilyn

> Consilyn is a Windows app for experts who take paid consultations. During a call the client has agreed to, it transcribes both sides on the expert's laptop (audio is never saved or sent) and shows short answers to read aloud, built from the expert's own screening answers and background. Every answer is labelled with its source, and AI-written text is marked not verified.

Key facts:

- Platform: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, 8 GB of memory. English only.
- Price: free during early access. After that, the first 5 calls are free, then 2 free calls a month; Consilyn Pro, with unlimited calls, is $39 a month, tax included. Payments by Dodo Payments, merchant of record.
- Where text goes: suggestions are written by Google Gemini with the user's own key. On Gemini's free tier, Google may use that text to improve its products and people may review it.
- The free-call counter receives only a scrambled laptop ID, a scrambled client-entry ID, the app version, call start times and the licence key; never anything said.
- Before it listens, the app asks the expert to confirm the client knows the call is transcribed on the laptop and its text sent to Google's AI.
- Works best with Zoom and Google Meet in Chrome. Speeds were measured with a paid Gemini key; on the free tier answers can be slow or missing.
- Download: free Windows installer at https://consilyn.com/#download (no account, no admin rights).
